title: Lamentations Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Lamentations 3: the man who has seen affliction, the loving kindnesses that are new every morning, and the cry out of the dungeon.

questions.text: How does the speaker describe himself in the first verse?
questions.explanation: He says: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

answers.text: As a prophet sent to speak to the nations
As a king driven away from his own throne
As a priest serving in the sanctuary
As the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath

questions.text: Where has he been led and caused to walk?
questions.explanation: He says he has been led and caused to walk in darkness, and not in light.

answers.text: In green pastures
In darkness, and not in light
On the mountains of Zion
Through deep waters

questions.text: What does the speaker say in verse 8 happens when he cries and calls for help?
questions.explanation: He says that when he cries and calls for help, his prayer is shut out.

answers.text: His chain is made light
An angel is sent to him
His prayer is shut out
The gate is opened to him

questions.text: What is he to the speaker, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: He says: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.

answers.text: As a bear lying in wait and a lion in secret places
As a shepherd who walks with his flock
As a wall of fire around him
As an eagle that watches over her young

questions.text: With what has he been filled and stuffed?
questions.explanation: He says he has been filled with bitterness and stuffed with wormwood.

answers.text: With milk and honey
With oil and wine
With bread and water
With bitterness and wormwood

questions.text: Why are we not consumed, and what is new every morning?
questions.explanation: It is because of Yahweh's loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, since his compassion does not fail; they are new every morning.

answers.text: Because of our own strength, renewed each day
Because of Yahweh's loving kindnesses, which are new every morning
Because of the prayers of the priests in Zion
Because the enemy has grown weary of fighting

questions.text: What does the speaker's soul say that Yahweh is?
questions.explanation: His soul says: Yahweh is my portion. Therefore I will hope in him.

answers.text: His portion
His enemy
Far from him
Silent toward him

questions.text: What does verse 27 say is good for a man?
questions.explanation: It says it is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

answers.text: That he gather riches in his youth
That he seek great things for himself
That he bear the yoke in his youth
That he keep silence all his days

questions.text: What does the speaker call the people to do in verse 40?
questions.explanation: He says: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.

answers.text: To build the walls of the city again
To go down to the land of Egypt
To offer sacrifice in the high places
To search and try their ways and turn again to Yahweh

questions.text: What happened when he called on Yahweh's name out of the lowest dungeon?
questions.explanation: He says Yahweh heard his voice, came near in the day that he called, and said: Don't be afraid.

answers.text: He was left without any answer at all
Yahweh heard his voice and said, Don't be afraid
The dungeon was shut over him forever
His enemies came and released him from it
